terms.title: Offer publishing conditions
terms.intro: Sharing an offer is free. So that every candidate can rely on it, every post on OPPORTINITIES follows the rules below. Please read them carefully before continuing.

authentic.title: An authentic offer
authentic.body: The offer really exists and comes from a verifiable source: the employer's official website, an institution, a newspaper, a professional network or an identifiable distribution channel.

valid.title: An offer that is still open
valid.body: The application deadline has not passed and the information is up to date when you share it.

accurate.title: A faithful copy
accurate.body: The information is copied without changes: title, requirements, salary, conditions and instructions. Nothing is added or embellished.

rights.title: The right to share
rights.body: The offer is public or its distribution is authorized. No confidential, internal or restricted document is shared.

free.title: No payment asked of candidates
free.body: An offer that asks candidates for application, training, visa or any other fees is forbidden: it is most often a scam.

lawful.title: Lawful and respectful content
lawful.body: Fraudulent, misleading or discriminatory offers, pyramid schemes and any illegal activity are forbidden. No personal data of third parties is published beyond the official application contact details.

moderation.title: Systematic review
moderation.body: Every offer is reviewed by our team before publication. It may be sent back to you for correction, rejected or suspended. Duplicates are detected.

commissions.title: Conditional commissions
commissions.body: You earn a commission on eligible unlocks of your approved offers. It is cancelled in case of fraud, duplicates or self-purchase. Rates and timeframes are shown in your account.

sanctions.title: Sanctions for abuse
sanctions.body: Failing to follow these rules may lead to offers being removed, related commissions being cancelled and the account being suspended.

terms.certify: I certify that the offers I share will be authentic, still open and faithfully copied.
terms.accept: I have read and accept the publishing conditions and the OPPORTINITIES <terms>terms of use</terms>.
